```{python}
import decoupler as dc
import scanpy as sc
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
```

```{python}
cars = sc.read_h5ad("2_car_only_annotated_v2.h5ad")
```

```{python}
collectri = pd.read_csv("../CollecTRI_regulons.csv")
collectri.head()
```

```{python}
dc.mt.ulm(data=cars, net=collectri)
```

```{python}
score = dc.pp.get_obsm(adata=cars, key="score_ulm")
score
```

```{python}
df = dc.tl.rankby_group(adata=score, groupby="Timepoint_bin", reference="rest", method="t-test_overestim_var")
df = df[df["padj"] < 0.05]
df
```

```{python}
n_markers = 10
source_markers = (
    df.groupby("group")
    .head(n_markers)
    .drop_duplicates("name")
    .groupby("group")["name"]
    .apply(lambda x: list(x))
    .to_dict()
)
source_markers
```

```{python}
plt.figure(figsize=(8,8))
sc.pl.matrixplot(
    adata=score,
    var_names=source_markers,
    groupby="Timepoint_bin",
    dendrogram=True,
    standard_scale="var",
    colorbar_title="Z-scaled scores",
    cmap="RdBu_r",
    swap_axes=True
)
plt.savefig("tf_enrichment/alltimepoints_tfs_heatmap.png", dpi=300)
plt.close()
```

```{python}
sc.pl.violin(score, keys ="NOTO", groupby="labels",rotation=45)
```

```{python}
gex_dn = cars[cars.obs["Timepoint_bin"] == "Late"].to_df().mean(0).to_frame().T
score_dn = score[score.obs["Timepoint_bin"] == "Late"].to_df().mean(0).to_frame().T

dc.pl.network(
    data=gex_dn,
    score=score_dn,
    net=collectri,
    sources=5,
    targets=10,
    size_node=5,
    figsize=(5, 5),
    s_cmap="viridis",
    t_cmap="RdBu_r"
)
```

```{python}
late = df[(df["group"] == "Late")]

top_up = late.nlargest(10, "stat")
top_down = late.nsmallest(10, "stat")

plot_df = pd.concat([top_down, top_up])
plot_df["name"] = plot_df["name"].cat.remove_unused_categories()
plot_df = plot_df.sort_values("stat")
```

```{python}
order = plot_df.sort_values("stat")["name"]
plt.figure(figsize=(8,6))
sns.barplot(plot_df, x = "stat", y = "name", hue = "stat", palette="RdBu_r", order=order)
plt.savefig("tf_enrichment/late_top_de_tf.png", dpi=300)
plt.close()
```

```{python}
plt.figure(figsize=(10,4))
sc.pl.matrixplot(
    adata=score,
    var_names=plot_df.name,
    groupby="Timepoint_bin",
    dendrogram=True,
    standard_scale="var",
    colorbar_title="Z-scaled scores",
    cmap="RdBu_r",
)
plt.savefig("tf_enrichment/late_tfs_heatmap.png", dpi=300)
plt.close()
```

```{python}
gex_late = cars[cars.obs["Timepoint_bin"] == "Late"].to_df().mean(0).to_frame().T
score_late = score[score.obs["Timepoint_bin"] == "Late"].to_df().mean(0).to_frame().T

sources = list(plot_df.name)
source_list = ["MYC", "HOXA2","E2F4","NFYB","NOTO"]

dc.pl.network(
    net=collectri,
    data=gex_late,
    score=score_late,
    sources=source_list,
    targets=10,
    size_node=8,
    size_label=0,
    figsize=(5, 4),
    layout="kk",
    s_cmap="RdPu",
    vcenter=False,
    t_cmap="GnBu",
    s_label="TF activity",
    t_label="log-normalized expression",
    save="tf_enrichment/late_tf_network.png"
)
```
